model_annotations.English: The chart represents the distribution of an unspecified variable across three categories. There are three slices shown. The blue slice, labeled "2019", accounts for approximately 46% of the total, with a corresponding value of 46. The orange slice accounts for around 33%, with a value of 33. The green slice, labeled "2017", makes up about 21%, with a value of 21. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction from largest to smallest.
model_annotations.German: The pie chart compares the distribution of data across three categories, labeled by year, with the overall number of segments being three. The segments are labeled as 2017, an unspecified year (colored orange), and 2019, colored blue. The green segment, labeled 2017, represents 21.0% (21) of the data. The orange segment, representing an unspecified year, accounts for 33.0% (33) of the data. The blue segment, labeled 2019, makes up 46.0% (46) of the data. The chart includes percentage values and numerical counts within each segment, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, starting from the top, with 2019 being the largest, followed by the unspecified year, and then 2017.
